title: クローム・パルス：忘却のレゾナンス
author: ネオン 零

en.title: Chrome Pulse: Resonance of Oblivion
en.premise: With the loss of Zenith's control, an 'Information Flood' of raw, unfiltered emotions begins to contaminate the network and ravage the city. As a 'Memory Sweeper' tasked with recovering the remnants of discarded emotions, I visit a mysterious shop that appears only on rainy nights. There, I acquire a log of a 'woman who shouldn't exist,' trapped within a mirror. As I pursue her true identity, I stumble upon the omen of a second catastrophe lurking in the city's depths: the 'Grand Synchronicity,' a phenomenon that threatens to synchronize all human consciousness.

zh.title: 铬脉：遗忘的共鸣
zh.premise: 随着 Zenith 管理权的丧失，充斥着原始情感、污染网络的“信息洪流”席卷了城市。身为一名回收废弃情感残渣的“记忆清道夫”，我在仅在雨夜现身的神秘店铺中，得到了一份被囚禁在镜中的“本不该存在的女性”的日志。在追寻她真实身份的过程中，我撞见了沉睡在城市深处的第二次毁灭预兆——旨在同步全人类意识的“大同步”（Grand Synchronicity）。

prediction_results.question: チップのノイズが引き起こす、カイの次の行動は？

自身の記憶に潜む違和感に気づく
謎の追跡者に街で襲撃される
